title: Godrej Properties — Risk & Reputation Research
content:
According to reviews on Trustpilot, customers have expressed significant dissatisfaction with Godrej Properties, citing issues such as project delays, lack of communication, and poor customer service. One reviewer mentioned a two-year delay and a lack of response from customer care. Another review highlighted non-refund and unresponsive sales personnel. On LinkedIn, users shared similar experiences of long-term possession delays and a loss of trust in the brand. These complaints suggest ongoing issues with delivery timelines, customer service, and adherence to promises.

However, there are reports of serious issues across most NCR projects, including poor construction quality, delayed possessions, and unresponsive customer relationship management. Buyers have also raised concerns about handover timelines slipping, the turnaround time for fixing snags after possession, and the speed of post-possession service response. These issues are project- and phase-specific rather than universal.

The sources indicate that Godrej Properties has been involved in multiple legal disputes. One case involves Anita Yadav suing Godrej Properties for allegedly charging the wrong GST rate on her residential unit purchase. Another case is a Supreme Court ruling on earnest money forfeiture in a real estate contract between Godrej Projects Development Limited and Anil Karlekar & Ors. Additionally, Godrej Properties reached a settlement with Orris Infrastructure Private Limited over a dispute concerning the Godrej Air project in Gurugram, with the Bombay High Court subsequently quashing an FIR against Orris Infrastructure. The sources do not provide a definitive answer on all aspects of these disputes.

The plaintiff Anita Yadav filed a civil suit against Godrej Properties Ltd regarding the applicable GST rate for her residential unit purchase. She argues that the builder wrongly charged 12% GST instead of the reduced 5% rate as per the February 2019 GST Council meeting. She has repeatedly asked Godrej to revise the rate but they have refused. The plaintiff seeks a court declaration that the 12% rate is invalid and the builder must return the excess amount charged with interest and penalties. [...] and penalties. She alleges the builder intentionally misled her and violated tax laws to unlawfully profit at her expense. [...] GST Dispute: Anita Yadav vs. Godrej Properties

No thumbnails available

In a recent judgment delivered by the Supreme Court of India, the Court addressed the contentious issue of earnest money forfeiture in real estate transactions. The case, titled Godrej Projects Development Limited vs. Anil Karlekar & Ors., involved a dispute over the cancellation of an apartment booking and the subsequent refund of payments made by the buyers. This article provides a comprehensive overview of the case, highlighting the key facts, rival contentions, and the Court's findings, [...] The dispute originated in January 2014 when the Complainants booked an apartment in the "Godrej Summit" project in Gurgaon, Haryana, and paid Rs. 10,00,000 as application money. An allotment letter was issued in June 2014, followed by an Apartment Buyer Agreement. The project was completed in June 2017, and possession was offered to the Complainants. However, due to a sharp decline in market prices, the Complainants sought cancellation of the booking and a full refund of the amount paid,

Orris Infrastructure Private Limited and Godrej Properties Limited have reached a settlement in relation to their dispute concerning the jointly developed Godrej Air project in Gurugram, according to information made public following a recent order of the Bombay High Court.

The Bombay High Court had quashed an FIR registered against Orris Infrastructure and another petitioner after recording that the parties had resolved their disputes and entered into a settlement agreement. [...] On August 27, the Court recorded that the parties had signed the settlement agreement and resolved their disputes. The matter was thereafter adjourned to enable completion of the remaining formalities before the final order was passed.

While allowing the petition, the High Court also made observations on cases in which criminal proceedings are subsequently sought to be quashed after private settlements. [...] The High Court order itself records the settlement between the petitioners and the original complainant and the consequent quashing of the FIR. Details regarding the Godrej Air project and the underlying commercial dispute have been stated separately by Orris Infrastructure in its public communication.

Godrej Properties faces criticism for delayed projects and poor customer service, as highlighted by reviews on Trustpilot and NoBroker.
